guides.title: 工程操作與定量驗證手冊
guides.concept: 以大士南設備更新為案例，學習把鍋爐、吹灰、灰渣輸送、煙氣處理與起重設備視為相互依賴的系統；延役須有性能證據。
guides.conceptEn: Using Tuas South refurbishment, treat boilers, soot blowing, ash transport, gas cleaning and cranes as interdependent systems; life extension requires performance evidence.
procedure: 先點選「進料品質基線」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把LHV改成6 MJ/kg，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 16.66667 MW。與基準 22.22222 MW比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「更新鍋爐熱量帳」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把蒸汽流率改成4 kg/s，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 9.6 MW。與基準 12 MW比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「延役前後淨效率」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把廠用改成1.5 MW，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 21.66667 %。與基準 23.33333 %比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「煙氣除塵可用面積」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把有效濾布降成800 m²，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 1.25 m/min。與基準 1 m/min比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「排放質量與有效資料」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把氣量改成120000 Nm³/h，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 2.4 kg/h。與基準 2 kg/h比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「灰渣輸送介面」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把垃圾量改成120 t/d，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 27.6 t/d。與基準 23 t/d比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「更新後廠用電」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把曝氣用電提高到3500 kWh/d，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 500 kWh/d。與基準 1200 kWh/d比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「新舊儀表一致性」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把樣品原讀值改成16.2，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 15.4 sensor unit。與基準 13.4 sensor unit比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「分期停爐能力」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把各列A改成0.90，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 0.99 fraction。與基準 0.9975 fraction比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「氣候與垃圾組成對照」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把對照地事後值改成27，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 -1 indicator unit。與基準 -2 indicator unit比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
procedureEn: Select the feed-quality baseline measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only LHV to6 MJ/kg with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 16.66667 MW. Compare with baseline 22.22222 MW and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the refurbished boiler duty measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only steam flow to4 kg/s with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 9.6 MW. Compare with baseline 12 MW and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the pre/post-refit net efficiency measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only auxiliaries to1.5 MW with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 21.66667 %. Compare with baseline 23.33333 % and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the available gas-cleaning area measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then reduce only active cloth to800 m² with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 1.25 m/min. Compare with baseline 1 m/min and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the emission mass and valid data measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only gas flow to120000 Nm³/h with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 2.4 kg/h. Compare with baseline 2 kg/h and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the ash-conveyance interface measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only waste to120 t/d with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 27.6 t/d. Compare with baseline 23 t/d and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the post-refit auxiliaries measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then increase only aeration demand to3500 kWh/d with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 500 kWh/d. Compare with baseline 1200 kWh/d and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the old/new sensor consistency measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only raw sample to16.2 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 15.4 sensor unit. Compare with baseline 13.4 sensor unit and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the phased shutdown capacity measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only each train availability to0.90 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 0.99 fraction. Compare with baseline 0.9975 fraction and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the weather/composition controls measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only control-after to27 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute -1 indicator unit. Compare with baseline -2 indicator unit and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.
evidence: 以代表性混合樣估熱值，核對秤重與蒸汽生成趨勢。在離線場景為「進料品質基線」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
使用同時壓力、溫度與流量，從蒸汽表核對焓狀態。在離線場景為「更新鍋爐熱量帳」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
以共同時窗核對燃料熱值、總發電與廠用負載。在離線場景為「延役前後淨效率」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
按隔室紀錄壓差、脈衝與排放趨勢，查破袋或離線面積。在離線場景為「煙氣除塵可用面積」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
同步氣量、濃度與氧含量，查校正狀態及無效資料標記。在離線場景為「排放質量與有效資料」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
各物流秤重並採代表性樣品，維持處置聯單與品質資料。在離線場景為「灰渣輸送介面」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
核對發電、購電與售電表，在相同邊界做全年帳。在離線場景為「更新後廠用電」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
用第二標準獨立驗證校正後殘差並記錄日期與溫度。在離線場景為「新舊儀表一致性」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
畫故障樹並標出共享設備，測試單列退出時的完整流程。在離線場景為「分期停爐能力」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
採同期多日資料並檢查前期趨勢，不選只對結果有利的一天。在離線場景為「氣候與垃圾組成對照」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
evidenceEn: Estimate heating value from representative composite samples and compare weighbridge and steam trends. Build an offline evidence table for feed-quality baseline; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

Use concurrent pressure, temperature and flow and check enthalpy states in steam tables. Build an offline evidence table for refurbished boiler duty; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

Reconcile fuel heating value, gross generation and auxiliaries over one interval. Build an offline evidence table for pre/post-refit net efficiency; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

Log compartment pressure drop, pulses and emissions and check broken bags or offline area. Build an offline evidence table for available gas-cleaning area; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

Synchronize gas flow, concentration and oxygen while checking calibration and invalid-data flags. Build an offline evidence table for emission mass and valid data; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

Weigh each stream, take representative samples and retain disposal and quality records. Build an offline evidence table for ash-conveyance interface; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

Reconcile generation, imports and exports within the same boundary over a year. Build an offline evidence table for post-refit auxiliaries; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

Use a second standard to verify corrected residuals independently and record date and temperature. Build an offline evidence table for old/new sensor consistency; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

Draw a fault tree marking shared assets and replay the process with one train unavailable. Build an offline evidence table for phased shutdown capacity; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

Use simultaneous multi-day data, inspect pre-trends and avoid selecting a favorable day. Build an offline evidence table for weather/composition controls; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
pitfalls: 高含水垃圾可使熱值下降；只依噸數預測發電會偏差。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
將飽和與過熱蒸汽混用會算錯能量。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
用高位熱值輸入搭配低位熱值比較值會錯置效率。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
濾袋破損可能讓壓差下降同時排放上升。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
稀釋煙氣可降濃度卻不降污染質量。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
混合底渣飛灰會失去追蹤與適切處理的依據。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
漏掉臭氣處理與污泥設備用電會誇大淨盈餘。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
以同一標準建立又驗證模型會隱藏校正偏差。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
兩列共用一個關鍵閥門，該閥失效仍會同時停產。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
處理地同時換交通流量會讓單一干預歸因失真。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
pitfallsEn: Wet waste reduces heating value; tonnage alone mispredicts power. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
Mixing saturated and superheated states gives an incorrect energy balance. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
Mixing higher- and lower-heating-value bases distorts comparisons. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
A torn bag can lower pressure drop while increasing emissions. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
Diluting flue gas lowers concentration without lowering pollutant mass. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
Mixing bottom and fly ash loses traceability and treatment distinctions. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
Omitting odor and sludge equipment overstates net surplus. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
Calibrating and validating with the same standard hides bias. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
A shared critical valve can stop both trains together. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
Concurrent traffic changes at the treated site confound attribution. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.

guides.scope: 公開原理與資料支持的原創教學。算例中的輸入為明示教學假設，非該設施實測或操作設定。此處任務在離線模型完成，不能作為現場設計、飲用水合格或設備操作許可。
guides.scopeEn: Original teaching based on public principles and sources. Numerical inputs are explicit teaching assumptions, not site measurements or operating setpoints. Tasks use offline models and do not certify field design, potable-water compliance or equipment operation.

related.why: 比較兩個系統的物質或能量收支，列出不可直接沿用的邊界條件。
related.whyEn: Compare material or energy balances and identify boundary conditions that cannot be transferred.
related.difference: 設備尺度、進料組成與品質目標必須分別設定。
related.differenceEn: Equipment scale, feed composition and quality objectives require separate definitions.
practice: 各選一個教學算例，記下輸入、輸出與單位。
對照兩課的系統邊界，說明哪些假設不能沿用。
改變一個輸入，提出量測與失效判據來核對結果。
practiceEn: Choose one worked example from each course and record inputs, outputs and units.
Compare system boundaries and identify assumptions that cannot transfer.
Change one input and propose measurements and failure criteria to check the result.
